referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA enters only as ancillary published fluxes, so any ALMA-based quantity inherits unstated processing from earlier papers
Large SED-fit uncertainties (about 50 percent on SFR and stellar mass) and limited MRS S/N (Halpha FWHM errors 15-20 percent) weaken the E versus W kinematic contrast
Dynamical masses assume dispersion-supported, relaxed gas, which the authors themselves doubt
The zeta_ion difference depends on UV and Halpha dust corrections and on the nebular continuum, which the paper notes are uncertain
